## Call Agent
Browser calls use WebSocket text. SIP calls use the app's Asterisk and a configurable speech pipeline; OpenAI Realtime STT transcribes continuously while the caller speaks, and replies are synthesized sentence by sentence as agent tokens arrive.

**Internal test** — set the Workspace LAN address, open **Linphone config** in the Call window, register ramal 101 and dial 700. The SIP and AMI passwords are generated automatically.

**Agent** — pick one that answers in short spoken prose. Every call resumes the same Target conversation.

**Agents Platform** — Tier-2 SIP calls need the base URL and identity token below; the container cannot read another app's private Settings.

**External number** — leave telephony disabled for the internal test. Later, add the Zadarma SIP credentials and enable it.

**Internet SIP (WAN)** — lets one softphone register from anywhere. It needs the LAN SIP trunk on, a public hostname, and UDP forwards on your router: **45060 → 45060** for signalling and **10000-10019 → 30000-30019** for audio (the ports differ on purpose). The four values to type into the softphone are below. Switching it off removes the SIP transport, but the host keeps those ports bound — **a full off means deleting the router rules too**. Nothing on this leg is encrypted.
